title: Put your inquiry form on your website
summary: Your inquiry form is how families reach you. Once it's on your site, every submission lands in your pipeline and gets an automatic reply.

steps.title: Open your form
steps.body: In the menu, go to Forms & Docs, then Forms. Open the folder called Prebuilt Forms and click Request Info Packet. You can use General Inquiry instead if you'd like a simpler contact form.

steps.title: Copy the embed code
steps.body: Click Integrate in the top right corner. Choose the embed option and click Copy. That's the code your website needs.

steps.title: Paste it on your website
steps.body: On WordPress, add a Custom HTML block where you want the form and paste the code. On Squarespace, use a Code block. On Wix, use Embed, then Embed HTML. If someone else manages your site, send them the code with a note about which page it goes on.

steps.title: Or let us do it
steps.body: If you don't have access to your website, give Banner 61 access and we'll add the form for you.

check: Fill out the form on your website with your own name and email. Within a minute you should see yourself in CRM, Opportunities, under New Inquiry, and the first email should be in your inbox. Delete the test contact when you're done.
